segments.title: Hype Train Cold Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station sign-on as 'Papita'; Hype Train commandeers feed with surreal freestyle about Bugs Bunny, Slender Man, and Daffy Duck.

segments.title: Trump Debate Withdrawal & Loomer/Greene Feud
segments.notes: Case reads Trump's Truth Social post declaring no third debate; covers Laura Loomer vs. Marjorie Taylor Greene public feud including racist remarks and personal attacks.

segments.title: Cats vs. Dogs: Which Tastes Better
segments.notes: Munch argues dogs are delicious; Crum argues cats are cleaner; debate devolves into personal insults, pet store ban tallies, and goldfish molestation accusations.

segments.title: Personal Updates & Fiona Nova
segments.notes: Case discusses year-long apartment limbo, second gold jacket purchase, and Fiona Nova's short film connection to Chappell Roan's VMA performance.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Scent Obsession & Kevin Pereira
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein in new gold coat interviews park denizens including Groomer Naughty, Blue Duce, Little Beaver Man, Perverted Tambin, Officer Park Ranger, Kevin Pereira impersonators, Jolly Jim, Hugh G. Jackman, and Curgurbing.

segments.title: Trend of the Movies: Vampire & Monster Trailers
segments.notes: Case and Chris watch trailers for The Radleys (vampire family), Carmen Sandiego (mobile game), and Monsters (No Country for Old Men-style family drama).

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Viral Videos with Garf
segments.notes: Garf hosts viral video review: Jeremy Fragrance, bear enemies-to-friends, Deputy Crow Adventures (cop content), JD Vance handshake, military cop skit, Richard Moorhead VFX showcase.

segments.title: Pepito's 'Food Now' Theme Song Debut
segments.notes: Pepito records original theme 'Food Now' on roof with DJ Music; chat supplies food lyrics; Susan makes auto-tuned cameo reading news paragraphs.

segments.title: Raid to Gina Darlin & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Broadcast ends with raid to Gina Darlin; Case reads Emperor's New Groove parody monologue as final send-off.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored broadcast, covered Trump debate withdrawal and Loomer/Greene feud, debuted second gold jacket, oversaw Pepito's theme song creation.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open as 'Papita,' later produced and performed 'Food Now' theme song with chat participation.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Commandeered early broadcast with surreal freestyle about Bugs Bunny, Slender Man, and Daffy Duck.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Brief walk-through appearance; mentioned back pain and apartment housing uncertainty.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued dogs taste better than cats, claimed six pet store bans, denied goldfish molestation rumors.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued cats taste better, accused of stealing Haitian valor, denied eating pets.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted park interviews from bush in new gold coat; revealed bee-stung legs, encountered scent-obsessed pedestrians and Kevin Pereira impersonators.

characters.name: Susan
characters.notes: producer. Cameo during Pepito's song; auto-tuned reading of news paragraphs.

lore_notes.fact: Case's apartment move remains unresolved after one year.
Case ordered a second gold jacket (washable version).
Trip Bradstein acquired a gold/technicolor dream coat.
Trip Bradstein suffered severe bee stings to lower body, legs and feet swollen.
Deputy Crow Adventures confirmed as active police officer who posts Baldur's Gate content.
Richard Moorhead creates high-quality action VFX in After Effects.
Pepito's original theme song 'Food Now' recorded live with chat-sourced lyrics.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered Trump's refusal of a third debate and the ensuing Laura Loomer–Marjorie Taylor Greene feud, then descended into a Munch & Crum debate on whether cats or dogs taste better. Trip Bradstein returned from his bush with a gold coat and bee-stung legs to interview a parade of scent-obsessed park denizens and Kevin Pereira impersonators. The broadcast closed with movie trailers, viral video review, and the live debut of Pepito's chat-written theme song 'Food Now' before raiding Gina Darlin.
